Method.name: AddRepToNcidObject
Method.Implementation: set newHddObj = ##class(ITFCOMMON.HDDLookup).%New() set newHddObj.Rep = rep set newHddObj.Domain = domain set newHddObj.Context = context Do reqObj.listOfHDDobj.Insert(newHddObj) $$$LOGINFO("Number of requests: " _ reqObj.listOfHDDobj.Count()) Quit $$$OK

Method.name: CreateHddReqObject
Method.Implementation: set reqObj = ##class(ITFCOMMON.HDDLookupRequest).%New() set reqObj.listOfHDDobj = ##class(%ListOfObjects).%New() return reqObj
